extracted_facts: Model Detail MST2: Cantilever from wall or edge beam.
Linking to be H8s at 300 unless otherwise specified.
Bends to be adjusted to suit on site (N.B.).
Position of H8 'U' bar specified separately from design reinforcement (specified by designer).
Distribution bars to be H10s at 300 unless otherwise specified.
Nominal H8 'U' bar shown at section A-A alongside design reinforcement and corner bar detailed with wall, with tension anchorage.
Main cantilever bars must be mild steel if they are to be rebent — cross-reference to Model Detail MW3 (not in this extract).
Nominal cover specified by designer (minimum 20mm or bar size, whichever greater). See also design notes 6.8.2 (not in this extract).
